title: PAR-134 AC1024 HATCH detached-string malformed-input control
baselineQualification: The shared worktree was already broadly dirty. This receipt records only the local test/plan slice and does not claim a clean checkout at baselineCommit.
scope: Exercise valid and malformed AC1024 HATCH detached-string streams in memory.
Verify a complete gradient name is parsed before the truncated second string payload is rejected.
Verify transactional cursor/model rollback and physical following-sentinel preservation without a committed DWG/DXF fixture.

implementation.testVector: A valid locally encoded AC1024 HATCH stream and a malformed stream whose detached UCS area contains the complete LINEAR gradient name followed by a length-one text with missing payload bytes.
assertions: Valid AC1024 parse yields LINEAR, SOLID, both gradient stops, and advances to the encoded handle boundary.
Malformed parse fails after the first string, leaves source cursor at bit zero, clears partially populated HATCH gradient/name state, and leaves the following 0xA5 sentinel physically intact.

assessment.ownerStatus: AC1024 detached-string malformed-input control implemented; overall PAR-134 remains partial.

Other CMC methods and broader HATCH/MPOLYGON semantics remain unqualified.
